description: The Veenpark is closed at this hour. The frame is the exterior of the reconstructed sod-hut hamlet, low turf walls and turf roofs along a dirt path, with a narrow peat canal. These huts are a museum reconstruction of the early peat settlement, not a street of untouched houses. It is partly cloudy, about 9.4°C, with wind near 6.8 km/h and cloud cover about 58%. No shop name and no train are shown.
